text:
## Training Objective  
Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements
effective 2026-03-01.
name: Chunk 2/4

raw_entities.name: Module 1 — Enhanced KYC Requirements (FCA-COBS-2026-03)
raw_entities.description: A training module designed to prepare staff for FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced Know Your Customer requirements effective 2026-03-01. The module covers the regulatory changes and their operational impact on customer verification processes.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

raw_entities.name: Understand Enhanced KYC Requirements Under FCA-COBS-2026-03
raw_entities.description: Staff must understand the specific enhanced Know Your Customer requirements mandated by FCA-COBS-2026-03 and their effective date of 2026-03-01.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

raw_entities.name: Compliance with FCA-COBS-2026-03 Enhanced KYC Requirements
raw_entities.description: Staff must comply with FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01. This is a regulatory obligation imposed by the Financial Conduct Authority.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

raw_entities.name: Enhanced KYC Verification Process
raw_entities.description: The enhanced Know Your Customer verification process required under FCA-COBS-2026-03, effective 2026-03-01. This represents an elevated standard for customer identity and address verification.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01
